definition: 品类分析以 products.category 和 order_items 为主表，通过 order_items.product_id 关联 products 表。

metrics.name: 品类销售额
metrics.sql_template: SELECT category, SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) FROM products JOIN order_items ON products.id = order_items.product_id GROUP BY category

metrics.name: 品类销量
metrics.sql_template: SELECT category, SUM(quantity) FROM products JOIN order_items ON products.id = order_items.product_id GROUP BY category

metrics.name: 品类销售占比
metrics.sql_template: 品类销售额 / SUM(品类销售额) * 100

metrics.name: 品类SKU数
metrics.sql_template: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category
